speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The Bill seeks to amend the National Environment Agency (NEA) Act to expand NEA's borrowing powers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: This is in line with the borrowing powers of other Statutory Boards, such as the Public Utilities Board (PUB), the Singapore Food Agency, JTC Corporation and the Housing and Development Board.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Section 23 of the NEA Act sets out the power for NEA to borrow.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: This will ensure that NEA is able to optimise the financing costs of any future borrowing.
